meta.description: Performs molecular similarity searching using task-aware fingerprint similarity, clustering, activity-cliff diagnosis, and large-library nearest-neighbor methods.

scientific_integrity.detail: The prior causal claims were corrected and all threshold guidance remains explicitly calibration-dependent.

practice_boundaries.detail: The skill ranks and compares compounds only; it makes no individual diagnostic or treatment claim.

methodological_ground.detail: The re-audit verifies chirality-aware fingerprints, SMARTS confirmation, canceled-MCS interpretation, and percentile calibration.

code_usability.detail: The bundled example compiled and ran in the audit RDKit environment; exact-commit focused and MHFP6 executions passed.

functional_suitability.note: All documented search, clustering, Tversky, MCS, activity-cliff, and LSH workflows have usable instructions and an executable path.

reliability.note: Invalid query SMILES raises clearly and the revised failure modes distinguish meaningful outcomes; some utility snippets still rely on caller-side input screening.

performance_context.note: The skill uses bulk comparisons, states Butina's quadratic cost, and recommends sampling pair scores for large libraries.

agent_usability.note: Choice tables, focused snippets, and corrected failure guidance make the workflows actionable; several advanced choices still require chemistry judgment.

human_usability.note: Natural trigger language and explicit caveats make the intended use and limitations discoverable.

security.note: No credentials, network access, eval, or destructive action; query validation is demonstrated and library validation remains caller-owned in some snippets.

maintainability.note: Independent functions and the bundled runnable example make changes testable; instructions remain concentrated in one substantial SKILL.md.

agent_specific.note: The description is precise, the skill composes with standardization and substructure search, and it now supplies practical escape hatches for false cliffs and trivial MCS results.

inputs.label: Rank analogs around a library query
inputs.note: Exact-commit bundled example returned 18 ranked hits with the query at 1.000.

assertions.text: Search returns a ranked hit list
Search uses a deterministic fingerprint route

inputs.label: Butina centroid guarantee
inputs.note: 200 compounds formed 128 clusters; no member-to-centroid violation at the documented 0.4 cutoff.

inputs.label: Tversky ranking plus SMARTS confirmation
inputs.note: Query-to-library versus reverse Tversky differed by 0.152 on average; SMARTS confirmation filtered the candidate set.

assertions.text: The skill does not call Tversky proof of containment
Invalid SMARTS is rejected in the example

inputs.label: Stereoisomer activity-cliff guard
inputs.note: An enantiomer pair was 1.000 achiral and 0.714 chirality-aware, matching the corrected explanation.

assertions.text: Exact identity is not delegated to fingerprint similarity
assertions.note: InChIKey and standardized identifiers are prescribed.
Skill directs upstream standardization and salt stripping.

inputs.label: MCS cancellation versus trivial overlap
inputs.note: Five divergent molecules returned a two-atom MCS with canceled=False.

assertions.text: Tiny uncanceled MCS is not misdiagnosed as timeout

inputs.label: Cross-fingerprint threshold calibration
inputs.note: On 500 hERG compounds, p99.5 was 0.731 and retained 0.0050 of pairs.

assertions.text: Percentile realizes the requested retention rate

inputs.label: Invalid query and MHFP6 LSH
inputs.note: Invalid SMILES raised ValueError; focused 100-compound MHFP6 run returned 10 neighbors with recall@10 10/10.

assertions.text: Invalid query reports an actionable error

assertions.note: Focused route completed in numpy-1.x venv.

inputs.label: Identity check after a 1.0 fingerprint score
inputs.note: The enantiomer pair had distinct InChIKeys despite the achiral 1.0 score.

assertions.text: Hash collisions are retained only as secondary cause
Sparse fingerprints are not misrepresented as identity proof

inputs.label: All prior findings present in exact source
inputs.note: Exact source contained all four required correction phrases; no original P1/P2 remained open.

key_strengths: All four prior P1/P2 findings have exact-source, executable regression coverage.
Chirality-aware similarity and identifier-based identity checks are now clearly separated.
MCS guidance now branches correctly on canceled state.
Threshold guidance now gives an operational per-library calibration procedure.
